skills.name: True Heart
skills.description: Cony throws hearts at enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -30% (7 sec) *ATK x 3300% Area Damage  *Enemy knockback

skills.name: Maid of the Day!
skills.description: Cony calls other Maid Conys. Bad effects on enemies. *Changes Dark elemental enemies to None (3 sec) *Summon Maid Cony (10 sec)  Maid Cony can use the following effect Skill when summoned. *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -30% (5 sec) *ATK x3300% Area damage for summoned Maid Cony *Enemy knockback  (Gear item effects won't be applied to Maid Cony when summoned.)

abilities.name: Resistance: Enemy Cost Increase
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability block enemies' Cost Increase Abilities.  - Affected Abilities: Enemy Cost Increase, Enemy Cost Increase 2

abilities.name: Training Troubler
abilities.description: Slow opposing team's unit production. (Production is slowed by per Ranger with this Ability that joins the battle)
